summary: A creative 3D game with role play, car driving and educational mini-games!
description:
Baby Panda's House Games is an aggregate app that gathers popular 3D games from BabyBus. In this app, kids can play 3D games featuring themes like ice cream, school bus, and restaurant. They can also explore Kiki's house freely, hunt for hidden design items, and engage in DIY activities. Every corner in the house is packed with surprises for kids to discover and create!

ROLE-PLAY
In the Baby Panda's House Games, kids can have fun playing 20+ occupational roles such as doctors, police officers, beauty artists, firefighters, and bakers! Each role has its own unique tasks and challenges, allowing kids to learn, explore, and create their own stories while learning about the diversity of the world through role-play.

DRIVING SIMULATION
Kids can also drive 25 different types of vehicles, including the school bus, police car, and fire truck, and explore all kinds of scenes, from cities to towns. Whether driving smoothly or at high speed, each task leads to a new adventure. The game provides a safe environment for kids to experience the fun of driving in a virtual world while learning about traffic safety.

BRAIN CHALLENGE
Baby Panda's House Games also includes many fun puzzles, like number puzzles, logic puzzles, and maze adventures. With an interesting story, each level of the game is designed to get kids thinking and using their brains. They will have fun while learning strategic planning skills and improving logical thinking and problem-solving abilities!

Baby Panda's House Games is more than just a collection of popular 3D games from BabyBus; it also acts as a companion for kids' development and learning. Let's explore Baby Panda Kiki's house together and set off on an exciting journey brimming with creativity and imagination!

FEATURES:
- Explore Kiki's open house freely;
- Includes 65 3D games from BabyBus that kids love;
- More than 20 characters for you to play;
- 160 episodes of fun cartoons;
- New games are added regularly;
- Easy to use; you can switch between mini-games at will;
- Supports offline play.
